title: Work budget runtime bound
statement: For all $n,k\in\mathbb{N}$, the exact sparse spectrum work budget, viewed as a real number, is at most $1+2^{171}\bigl(12(n+1)(2^k+1)^2\bigr)^{100}$.
caveat: The work budget is defined through a detailed accounting of preprocessing, sampling, and learning operations; the payload does not provide standalone informal descriptions of those component definitions.
